title: wilma-triage
summary: Daily triage of Wilma school notifications for Finnish parents. Fetches exams, messages, news, schedules, and homework — filters for actionable items, syncs exams to Google Calendar, and reports via chat. Requires the `wilma` skill and `gog` CLI (or `gog` skill from ClawHub) for calendar access.
type: skills
